title: Four lanes, one add
prompt:
Four players finish a round, and each of them earns the same bonus. The starter reads the four scores and then the bonus (`12 30 7 25` and `5` in the stdin box) into memory. Add the bonus to all four scores with one vector `add`, then total the new scores with `addv`.

Load the scores into the lanes of `v0` with `ld1`, and put the bonus in every lane of `v1` with `dup`. `printf` reads its `%d` values from `w` registers and may change any `v` register, so copy the lanes out with `mov w1, v2.s[0]` and the like, and keep the total in `total_r` before the first call. The vectors lesson shows each of these instructions.

## What is checked

- the four new scores print on one line, and the total on the next
- the program exits cleanly
- the work is done in the lanes (`ld1`, `dup` and `addv`), and the total is not hardcoded
- the same holds for other scores you do not see, negative scores and a bonus of 0 or below among them
starter:
// add one bonus to four scores with a single vector add, then total them
define(fp, x29)
define(lr, x30)

define(total_r, w19)

        .data
fmt_in:     .string "%d %d %d %d %d"
fmt_scores: .string "scores: %d %d %d %d\n"
fmt_total:  .string "total: %d\n"

        .bss
        .align 4
scores_m:   .skip 16                        // four ints, one v register's worth
bonus_m:    .skip 4

        .text
        .balign 4
        .global main
main:
        stp     fp, lr, [sp, -16]!
        mov     fp, sp

        ldr     x0, =fmt_in                 // read four scores, then the bonus
        ldr     x1, =scores_m
        add     x2, x1, 4
        add     x3, x1, 8
        add     x4, x1, 12
        ldr     x5, =bonus_m
        bl      scanf

        // TODO: load the four scores into the lanes of one v register,
        // put the bonus in every lane of another, and add the two in one
        // instruction. Total the four new scores with addv into total_r.
        mov     total_r, 0

        ldr     x0, =fmt_scores
        ldr     x9, =scores_m               // for now, the scores without the bonus
        ldr     w1, [x9]
        ldr     w2, [x9, 4]
        ldr     w3, [x9, 8]
        ldr     w4, [x9, 12]
        bl      printf

        ldr     x0, =fmt_total
        mov     w1, total_r
        bl      printf

        mov     w0, 0
        ldp     fp, lr, [sp], 16
        ret
